'''Paul Davis''' (born [[21 July]], [[1984]]) is a [[college basketball]] [[Center (basketball)|center]] who plays for the [[Michigan State University athletics#Men's basketball|Michigan State Spartans]]. He finished the 2005 season as the [[NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Championship|NCAA Tournament]]'s leading rebounder. He has been ranked as the nation's number three center by ''[[Lindy's College Basketball]]'' and the nation's number five [[Center (basketball)|post man]] by ''[[Athlon Sports]]''. Davis will undoubtidly go on to play pro basketball in the NBA, after his career at MSU.
